holdoutPolicy: New exports are evaluation holdouts; do not use them for document-specific tuning. Shared repairs can be driven by the selected mark and retained development documents. All holdout variants are reported; failures cannot be dropped.
sourcePolicy: Use unmodified independently published SVG exports and verify public-domain Commons metadata and upstream identity before public admission. No candidate pixels or unsupported-feature filtering determine file choice. Prefer a flat named logo/wordmark over a combined symbol-and-name export solely to preserve the predeclared stratum.
plannedVariants: Small/intended/large, transparent/white/black, scale 1. Preserve explicit historical declared viewport obligations when freezing; add practical logical viewports chosen from source aspect ratios before candidate measurement.
